snippet.title: A Fighter's Nova: Mindara! - Exclusive Game Announcement Trailer! Convergence Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
A Fighter’s Nova Mindara is a narrative JRPG that blends rich storytelling with the fast-paced action of a true tag-team fighting game. Play as teenage martial artist Maya and Mindara, a mysterious wolf-man on a path of revenge. Along the way, you’ll recruit companions with unique stories, and experience a true JRPG adventure where wisdom and redemption are forged through the art of combat.

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/badrezgames/a-fighters-nova-mindara?ref=discovery&total_hits=1185&category_id=35
